$comment: Machine-readable index of frozen release artefacts under data/releases/. The static leaderboard page consumes this to render the 'Frozen cohorts' panel; the article CI also reads it to verify the v3 dataset / scores files exist before publishing.

releases.title: v3.3 — 1000-repo cohort re-scan with agent-readiness 2.4.6 (rules pack v2.4.1)
releases.purpose: Validation snapshot for the 2026-05-21 calibration cycle. Same v3.2 cohort, re-scanned after the safety.gitleaks_config precondition gate (engine v2.4.5) and the rules-pack vendor bump (engine v2.4.6). Paired against scores_v3_1000_2026-05-02.json: safety.gitleaks_config 64.9% -> 62.2% (-2.6 pp); gitignore.covers_junk 61.4% -> 59.7% (-1.7 pp, v2.4.4 fix intact).

releases.title: JVM-skewed v1 — 144 repos × 12 languages, baseline scan with agent-readiness 2.4.6
releases.purpose: Language-stratified validation cohort built because the v3 cohort (topic-keyed: llm/agents/rag) under-represents JVM and long-tail-language ecosystems (0 Scala, 1 Clojure, 1 Julia, 6 Kotlin, 15 Java in 993 v3 repos). 12 production repos per language. First baseline scan with v2.4.6: safety.gitleaks_config aggregate 42.7% — 22.2 pp below the v3-cohort 64.9% baseline, the population-level signal the precondition gate was designed to produce. Becomes the comparison baseline for the next calibration cycle.
